## Nvidia and Palantir don't trust Claude with their secrets

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/7eaa8f8c-b4cb-489a-96e0-39f84a7744c3/Sep_15_-_1.jpg?t=1789461330)
Caption: 

Nvidia, Palantir and Booz Allen Hamilton are [restricting how much of their own data touches](https://www.reuters.com/business/palantir-nvidia-curb-ai-model-use-over-data-fears-information-reports-2026-09-14/) Anthropic and OpenAI models.

Nvidia keeps Anthropic's models on low-stakes internal work and runs its own Nemotron models on anything proprietary. Booz Allen has banned staff from putting Anthropic's commercial model anywhere near cybersecurity projects that involve client data.

Palantir went further and asked Anthropic to guarantee zero data retention before it makes those models available inside its software.

The trigger was the 30-day retention policy Anthropic introduced in June alongside Fable 5. Thirty days is a long time to be holding a defense contractor's files.

Anthropic has already answered with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which lets customers keep their activity data in their own S3, Azure or Google Cloud storage under their own encryption keys.

Most of these companies are Anthropic partners or customers, so this is a negotiation happening in public.

79131.subject: The Anthropic IPO: Top 10 Stocks Positioned to Benefit Most 💸
79131.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/anthropic-ipo-stocks

👋 Hey, Linas here! Every day, I break down 3 stories shaping the future of FinTech & Artificial Intelligence - plus the money movements and trends worth tracking. First time here? 397k+ FinTech and AI leaders get this daily. Join them:
Anthropic has picked Nasdaq for an IPO that could value it at $2 trillion or more [ https://substack.com/redirect/6b1db3ff-a85f-46af-bbf1-aaec8f362521?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], the Financial Times reported on Sunday, in the same week Sam Altman told Fortune that OpenAI [ https://substack.com/redirect/02e75baa-7fa3-4f6f-aae7-85ba260a3621?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] will stay private this year because the moment is wrong for a listing. Anthropic has also told a small group of shareholders that its adjusted operating income, which excludes stock-based compensation, will be positive for a second straight quarter.
The growth behind that claim is truly steep.
Second-quarter revenue rose 14-fold from a year earlier to $11.5 billion, and annualized revenue reached $65B at the end of July, from $9B at the end of 2025.
Gross margins run above 80%, before revenue shared with distribution partners such as Amazon and before the cost of training models (more about this here [ https://substack.com/redirect/e680b371-2bfc-4af4-8621-43104dfae4f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]).
Investors expect $120 billion of annualized revenue by year-end and almost 3x that by the end of 2027, according to SemiAnalysis’s Joey Brookhart.
Bankers have discussed a raise of as much as $100 billion, which would be the largest IPO in history, surpassing even SpaceX [ https://substack.com/redirect/f24c5aaf-2177-4234-9a47-d83777a72450?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. But rather than publishing its prospectus last week as expected, the company shared it with a small group of investors first and will take their questions before making it public. We’re watching this closely 👀
Most retail investors who want an allocation will definitely not get one, and they are not missing much.
Five of the ten companies below already own Anthropic equity. Three more hold compute contracts with it worth a combined $24.6 billion. The two cloud providers that run most of its training have booked more than $300 billion of Anthropic spending commitments into their backlogs, the pool of contracted future revenue they report to investors each quarter.
In other words, the IPO puts a public price on positions that already exist. Equity stakes carried at the last private round therefore get revalued against a daily quote, and contracts get a customer with a public balance sheet and up to $100 billion of fresh cash to pay for them.
As we argued earlier [ https://substack.com/redirect/8dfe4aa6-7a11-4fde-aec6-0852f307a75a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0
